name: clipninja
description: Minimal clipboard and template manager for macOS (Cmd+Shift+V / Cmd+Shift+B).

scripts.mac:reset-apple-events: bash -c 'echo "Resetting Apple Events (Automation) for all apps. You will be prompted again."; tccutil reset AppleEvents'
scripts.icon:png: sips -s format png assets/icon.svg --out assets/icon.png || true

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: ClipNinja uses Automation to detect the app you were using and to paste text into its text field via System Events.
